Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling straight through the intersection in Katy, Texas, when Driver 2 turned left acorss the path of
Driver 1's vehicle and the two cars collided in the intersection. Driver 2 told the responding officer that the turn was
made without seeing the oncoming vehicle, and the other driver confirmed that account at the scene. Independent
witnesses gave statements consistent with the sequence of events, and several took photographs of the vehicles
before they were moved. Those photographs show front-end damage to Driver 1's vehicle and right-side damage to
Driver 2's vehicle, which is consistent with the angle and force of the impact described. Officers obesrved no prior
damage of a different age or type on either vehicle. Driver 1 was seated behind the wheel when officers arrived, and a
Passenger was also present in the vehicle, as confirmed by both wtinesses and the other driver. Driver 1 reported
pain in the right knee and was evaluated at the scene before bieng transported for further care. Driver 1 is listed as a
named insured on the policy covering the vehicle involved.
